name: Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce
author: Yuky Hendiawan

sections.description:
The Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce plugin enhances your WooCommerce store by displaying real-time notifications of sales and orders. This engaging feature helps create a sense of urgency and social proof, encouraging more customers to make purchases.

With this plugin, you can easily set up customizable popups that inform your visitors when a sale occurs, increasing the likelihood of conversion. The notifications are visually appealing and can be configured to match the style of your website.
sections.installation:
1. Open WordPress Dashboard:
    Log in to your WordPress dashboard.

  2. Access Plugin Menu:
    On the left panel, click “Plugins” and select “Add New.”

  3. Search for “Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce”:
    On the Add Plugin page, locate the search box in the top right corner.
    Type “Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce” in the search box.

  4. Install the Plugin:
    After finding the “Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce” plugin, click the “Install Now” button below it.

  5. Activate the Plugin:
    Once the installation is complete, click the “Activate” button that appears.

  6. You’re Ready to Use the Plugin:
    After activation, navigate to the “Live Sales Popup Notification for WooCommerce” section in your WordPress dashboard to start importing and exporting menus.
